final_text: The design is fixed and all tests pass. The bug was in state `S101`: on `din=0` it incorrectly transitioned to `IDLE` instead of `S10`, which dropped the valid overlapping `"10"` prefix match (e.g. in the `10101011` case the spec calls out). Changed `S101: next = din ? S1011 : IDLE;` to `S101: next = din ? S1011 : S10;`, and `tb/tb_visible.v` now reports `TEST PASSED`.
